name: Ho Bee Land Limited
summary: Ho Bee Land Limited is a real estate company. Listed on the Mainboard of the Singapore Exchange since 1999, Ho Bee has a global footprint that spans Australia, China, United Kingdom and Europe. Its portfolio covers many quality residential, commercial and high-tech industrial projects since its inception. In Singapore, Ho Bee is widely recognised as the pioneer developer of luxury homes in the exclusive residential enclave of Sentosa Cove.
